hooks.text: 时间是核心资源，玩家必须在延长剩余时间与提升杀伤力之间持续取舍。
hooks.excerpt: Time is your ultimate resource, but your hero’s lethality is just as vital. Every choice matters: forge your character and sharpen your strategy. You must strike a balance between gaining time and boosting your firepower.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 地下城探索获得的资源、武器和法术会转化为村庄防御能力，两种阶段协同推进破局。
hooks.excerpt: Master the synergy between dungeon crawling and village defense to finally break the loop and save your kin. Experience a unique hybrid of Dungeon Crawler and Action-RPG, featuring intense village defense phases
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 神秘时钟迫使主角反复经历村庄毁灭，通过循环积累力量以违抗命运并拯救亲族。
hooks.excerpt: A mystical clock now looms amidst the ruins, forcing you to relive the massacres from the past in a relentless loop. In these dreams, time is short and always runs out. Will you seize this cycle to defy fate and save your kin?
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 局外成长显得缓慢且需要刷取。
核心循环很有吸引力，让玩家想再开一局。
